title: fix(components): a related-list tab badge keeps following its list after a row action
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTDAJKyXUan6fJCKsZUf5Pv)_

Fixes #36922

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户在记录页的关联列表里先执行一次行操作(如「标记完成」)后，再删除或新建子记录，页签上的数量角标现在会随列表一起更新，不再停在旧数字直到刷新。
- 属于记录页关联列表体验修复，替在记录页上处理关联子表的用户解决角标与列表数字对不上的问题。
- 出错时影响的是角标数字：最坏是多发一次计数请求或角标短暂不更新，不改任何数据，可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

`RelatedCountStore.fetch` (`@object-ui/components`) now settles on a count the store holds. When a change overtakes the read a fetch joined (an invalidation, `invalidateAll`, a newer seeded read, or a rail card's `releaseRows`), the read is marked `overtaken` and the fetch takes the count a newer read installed, joins the read now in flight, or reads again. A read that fails without being overtaken still answers `0` with nothing cached.

## Why

Measured on `main` (4f19091997) in a browser, showcase app, Projects → open a project in the drawer → Tasks related tab:

1. A row action (`Mark Done`, a flow-free `update`) reaches the data-change bus twice, a beat apart: the dataSource write's own mutation event, then `notifyRelatedChanged` from `RelatedRecordActionsBridge.runRowAction` once the runner returns.
2. The first change makes `useRelatedCounts` (the record page's tab-badge reader, `plugin-detail`) send a re-count. The second change overtakes it while it is out: `invalidate` drops the in-flight entry, so the read installs no count when it answers.
3. `fetch` still resolved with that read's number. `useRelatedCounts` reads "resolved and nothing cached" as a failed read and adds the key to its per-parent failed set. A failed key is never asked again for the record open, and the badge draws its last known number.
4. Every later write (delete, create) invalidates the store, but the reader skips the failed key: the badge stays on the old number until a reload.

A plain delete reaches the bus once, so no read is overtaken; that is why the control in the issue refreshes. The page-tabs badge (`page:tabs`, an authored page) is not affected: it re-fetches on every store version and keeps no failed set.

Fixed at the store, not the reader: `fetch` answering with a number for data that has changed, without caching it, is the contract gap; with it closed, the reader's inference ("resolved and nothing cached" = failed) is true again. No public type or accept set changes.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/useRelatedCounts-27056.test.tsx`, new top-level `describe` (objectstack#36922): drives the real bus (`notifyDataChanged`) through the store into `useRelatedCounts`. Row action (two changes, the second while the re-count is out) then delete → re-counted to 8; row action then create → re-counted to 10; plain-delete control → 8.
- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/related-count-store.test.ts`, new top-level `describe`: an overtaken fetch reads again and resolves with the installed count; it joins a newer caller's read instead of sending a third; a non-overtaken failure still answers `0` with nothing cached.

<details><summary>Red on main, green with the fix, ablation</summary>

- On main (pins only, commit 3bd578ea): `Tests 2 failed | 9 passed (11)` — both row-action pins `AssertionError: expected 2 to be greater than 2` (no read after the delete/create); the plain-delete control passes.
- With the fix: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 48 passed (48)` (the hook file plus all five `related-count-store*` suites).
- Head: tests ran at 0227fb6837; the head 6d5352dadd adds only the changeset on top of it (no source byte differs). `type-check` of `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (both programs, source and `tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0 after building their dependency closure.
- Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor `if (!pending.overtaken) return total;` → `return total;`, anchor x1 → x0, blob da95bc4e → a2897c4f): `Tests 4 failed | 18 passed (22)` — the four new overtaking pins red, both controls green; restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. Both suites import the store from source (the hook suite went red → green on a `components/src`-only change), so no build sits between the mutation and the run.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Create after a row action (unchecked in the issue): on main it is missed the same way (the create reaches the bus as a change to the child, and the failed key is skipped). Pinned above, and checked in the browser with the fix.
- A header (record-level) action was not checked; it reaches the bus through the same store, and an overtaken re-count there would have taken the same path.
- `useRelatedCounts` still never re-asks a key whose read really failed, for the rest of the record open, and draws its last known count meanwhile. That is unchanged and out of this card (no measured repro).
- #36822 (badge blanking on a zero-row refetch) is a different defect and is untouched.

## Verification

Browser, showcase on its own port (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`), Console from `ui/` source through Vite, drawer on a project's Tasks tab, the issue's exact sequence:

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

| Run | Tree | Sequence | Badge after | List rows | Server total |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| repro | main | `Mark Done` on one row, then Delete another, read 7 s later | **Tasks 5** | 4 | 4 |
| control | main | fresh load, Delete one row | Tasks 1 | 1 | 1 |
| fix | branch | `Mark Done`, then Delete | Tasks 3 | 3 | 3 |
| fix, create | branch | `Mark Done`, then Add → save | Tasks 3 | 3 | 3 |
| fix, control | branch | fresh load, Delete one row | Tasks 2 | 2 | 2 |

On main the row action sent one count read (the overtaken one) and the delete sent none; with the fix the row action sends two (the overtaken one, then the re-read) and the delete one more. Time from the tab drawing to its badge on a fresh load is unchanged (170–600 ms with the fix, 230–450 ms with the fetch loop ablated, dev-server Vite on a shared box).
</details>

Read first: `ui/packages/components/src/hooks/related-count-store.ts` — the `fetchCount` loop and the `overtake` call sites (the `seed` and `releaseRows` ones change behaviour too: a fetch that joined a replaced read now follows the newer read instead of answering with the old one).

Two-minute check: open a project in the drawer on its Tasks tab, run `Mark Done` on one row, then delete another row — the tab badge drops by one with the list.
